metadata.description: Field test protocol for Option C Phase C1.1: Mac to Freebox relay validation. 6 sections: local fail-fast, Freebox startup/health, E2E relay, robustness, continuity, report format.
Protocol v1.0 to infrastructure plan. 4 sequential gates: C1 (Relay Fleet MVP), C2 (Discovery+multi-relay), C3 (Monitoring), C4 (Client MVP). Wire invariants traps listed.

EmbeddedRelayService in tom-protocol/src/runtime/embedded_relay.rs. Types: EmbeddedRelayStatus (Stopped/Starting/Healthy/Failed), EmbeddedRelayConfig, EmbeddedRelayService. RuntimeEffect variants: StartEmbeddedRelay, StopEmbeddedRelay.

RelayRegistry in discovery/relay_registry.rs owned by RuntimeState. TTL-based expiration (default 10 min). UpsertResult enum: Inserted/RefreshedSameUrl/UpdatedUrl. RuntimeHandle::get_known_relays() API.

Strategic realignment. 5 blocks: A (operability ~80% done), B (demo ~70%), B' (IPv6-first), C (relay loop closure), D (alpha multi-node), E (product surface). IPv6 rationale: relay publishes LAN IP not routable from Internet.
Sprint 1 planning: wow moment = 3-node scenario relay publish/discover/inject/message. 5 metrics M0-M4. S1 gate must pass before polish. 3 rails: R1 (wow moment), R2 (network loop), R3 (operability).

Sprint 1 results: 4h session. M1=25s PASS, M2=4 FAIL (target 3), M3=18/20=90% PASS, M4=100% PASS. Bug A: EmbeddedRelayService never auto-started. Friction #1: first publication missed by late joiners.

Lock cross-machine proof before new features. Context: relay publishes LAN IP (not 127.0.0.1), bot-ping targets named peer not n0 anonymous, Path changed: Direct observed ~45ms RTT. 3 deliverables, 4 acceptance criteria.

NAS (publisher+self-relay:3340) ↔ Mac (observer+bot-ping) ↔ Apple TV (observer+auto-echo, tvOS FFI). Smoke test PASS: 1579 MSG from, 25 ECHOs, 0 errors on Apple TV. Manual bootstrap still used (patch removed hardcoded relay/bootstrap 2026-03-30).

Conceptual framing of bootstrap pump vs classic bootstrap. Metaphor: secretary playing musical chairs. 4 maturity levels: birth, growth, autonomy, maturity. Rejects: fixed server list, eternal bootstrap, permanent dependency on initial carrier.

Concrete implementation skeleton on copilot/bootstrap-pump-skeleton branch. New types: BootstrapHint::MdnsDiscovered, BootstrapPhase (Idle/LanProbe/RelayAssist/DhtAssist/Converged). 8 files to touch, 3 implementation lots.

Mission brief for Claude as contre-architecte for bootstrap pump. Read-only/analysis mode. Requests: Variant A/B/C architectures, recommendation, invariants, incremental implementation checklist. No code editing.
Short directive: do not open large multi-device checkpoint or Apple TV demo now. No scope expansion. Stay focused on current work.
Two subtests: strict organic (no seed at all) vs seed handoff (runtime-only seed then remove). PASS criteria: peers still visible, messages continue, no re-seeding needed, useful relay still known.
Copilot: code cartography and integration. Claude: architecture critique, design variants, security/UX/resilience. Rules: one agent modifies code at a time. Use 2 branches or 2 worktrees.

Protocol to measure impact of peer_present_k (k=8 baseline, k=16, k=32). Results (40 nodes, 10 runs): k=8 best (100% bootstrap, 3340ms NeighborUp, 803ms delivery). k=8 optimal on mono-Mac relay-only topology.

metadata.description: Pre-macOS-update checkpoint on copilot/bootstrap-pump-skeleton branch. PeerPresent path validated. Bootstrap pump/LAN-first code added. Relay fanout k=8/16/32 configurable. Local k measurement blocked by direct-path storm on mono-machine.
Distributed rotating bootstrap function: role exists but bearer changes. Non-hardcoded, invisible to users, with handoff and rotation semantics.
Starts/stops a real tom-relay inside the node process. Status: Stopped/Starting/Healthy/Failed. Lifecycle via RuntimeEffect pattern.
Local store of RelayReadyAnnounce entries. TTL-based expiration (default 10 min). One relay max per node. UpsertResult: Inserted/RefreshedSameUrl/UpdatedUrl.
Consumes RelayRegistry to dynamically inject/remove relay URLs into tom-connect Endpoint transport layer. Flag enable_transport_relay_discovery (default false).
BootstrapPhase enum: Idle/LanProbe/RelayAssist/DhtAssist/Converged. Orchestrates bootstrap discovery phases in tom-protocol/src/runtime/bootstrap.rs.
peer_present_k controls relay fanout. k=8 optimal (100% bootstrap, 803ms delivery median). k=16 and k=32 degrade performance on mono-Mac relay-only topology.
tom-dht crate wrapping Mainline DHT BEP-0044. Key=SHA1(NodeId), Value=signed{NodeAddr,timestamp,relay_urls,direct_addrs}, TTL=24h, re-publish every 12h.
4-gate infrastructure plan: C1 (Relay Fleet MVP), C2 (Discovery+multi-relay), C3 (Monitoring), C4 (Client MVP). Wire invariants must be respected.
Runtime-only seed injection then removal. Steps: A (lift seed), B (join without hardcoding), C (propagation), D (remove seed), E (PASS criteria: network continues without seed).
Forked from iroh-relay. Stateless relay server + client. ~8K LOC.
New crate, not a fork. Mainline DHT BEP-0044 wrapper with publish() and lookup() methods, 5s timeout.
Added local_discovery, BootstrapHint, bootstrap.rs, mDNS wiring in TomNode. Modified Cargo.toml, config.rs, lib.rs, node.rs in checkpoint.
Added runtime/bootstrap.rs, unified add_peer_addr()+join_peers() pipeline in runtime/loop.rs. EmbeddedRelayService auto-start fixed.

Integration test: peer_present_auto_discovery_leads_to_neighbor_up_and_delivery. Validated: PeerPresent -> GossipNeighborUp -> delivery path works. Observed: bootstrap accepted peer hint, NeighborUp both sides.

New benchmark binary at crates/tom-integration-tests/src/bin/peer_present_k_matrix.rs. Env params: PEER_PRESENT_KS, PEER_PRESENT_NODE_COUNT, PEER_PRESENT_TRIALS etc. Blocked by direct-path storm on mono-Mac.
M0 corridor test, M1 setup time (<5min), M2 commands (<=3), M3 discovery success (>=90% on 20 runs), M4 stability (100% on 10min). Actual: M1=25s PASS, M2=4 FAIL, M3=90% PASS, M4=100% PASS.
MdnsAddressLookup exists in tom-connect but not activated in tom-transport yet. Bootstrap pump Phase 1 = LAN-first via mDNS. BootstrapHint::MdnsDiscovered{endpoint_addr}.
